purpose: Teach: チビ/見聞き/吐き出し/むき出し/ずらりと/自ずと/がんばら/追い込ん

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが孫を「チビっ子」って優しく呼んでらした
lines.en: You know, Gran — when I was young, Father used to call the grandchildren 'chibi-tots' so gently.
lines.style: Soft, distant gaze into memory. Voice unhurried, almost speaking to himself. Warm but tinged with loss. Breath settles on the recalled word.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、戦中の事を見聞きされた方だったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear — your father, he saw things during the war, didn't he? He was the type to carry that.
lines.style: Gentle affirmation. Understanding nod in the voice. Slight lift at the end—not a question, but an opening for him to continue. Warm, steady presence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは胸の内を吐き出して下さらなかった
lines.en: Gran — when I was young, Father never really opened up about what was inside him.
lines.style: Quieter now. Slight strain underneath—not bitterness, but the weight of unspoken things. Measured pace. Voice tightens slightly on the word 'opened.'

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、感情をむき出しにされなかった寡黙な方だったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your father was a quiet man, wasn't he, dear — didn't let his feelings show. That's how he was.
lines.style: Soft recognition. Not stating a problem, but naming what was. Compassionate firmness. A small pause before 'quiet'—honoring the difficulty without flinching from it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんの本がずらりと並んだ部屋を懐かしむ
lines.en: Gran — I still miss that room when I was young. The one with all his books lined up on the shelves.
lines.style: Voice brightens slightly—a small shaft of light. Slower pace, almost dwelling on the image. Gentle nostalgia, not regret. Breath softens at 'books.'

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、晩年は自ずと家族に頼られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: By the end of his life, the family came to depend on him, didn't they? He became what they needed.
lines.style: Affirming, slightly proud undertone. Voice settles into recognition of quiet strength. Warm closure—she's seen the whole arc. Slight exhale of peace at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは家族のためにがんばらないと、と仰った
lines.en: Gran — Father used to say, when I was young, that he had to keep working hard for the family's sake.
lines.style: Voice carries a mix of respect and something heavier—duty, almost resigned. Steady delivery, but with an edge of strain on 'had to.' Matter-of-fact, but not cold.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、限界まで自分を追い込んで働かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He pushed himself to the very limit, didn't he, dear — worked until there was nothing left to give.
lines.style: Voice carries weight but no blame. Recognition of sacrifice. Quiet firmness—she's naming hard truth with tenderness. Slight catch, as if the words cost her something to say.
